Name: Better Shopping Cooking
Author: QueenQuackin
Description:
[size=3]Have you ever sighed to yourself wishing you could just [i]buy[/i] a second furnace, a few extra kegs, some wooden paths… or even battery packs? Now you can!
[b]Better Shopping[/b] lets you purchase a wide range of vanilla machines, resources, décor items, and more. If you can craft it, you can buy it.
To keep things balanced, most items won’t become available until you’ve unlocked their crafting recipe or met another specific requirement. (These conditionals are listed in the Articles tab.) Nearly if not every purchasable item is configurable you decide whether it’s available and exactly how much it costs. Make your shopping experience as convenient or as challenging as you like. In the next update there will be a config option so that if you don't want conditionals on your items you can toggle it off. Available Stock configure options now available! -1 is unlimited purchases

This Edition: Cooking

Well Queen What can I buy? Here is the master list of items!
